g.text: Conditional FGF2–GAP43 association: b = -0.099 per mediator SD, p = 4.3e-05, BH FDR = 0.000712 | Dx attenuation = 18.8%
Values remove centered age, sex and SpD effects; middle panel also removes the centered mediator effect.
ΔDx = SCZ − NTC. P-values/FDR are from the original donor-blocked limma fits; boxes supply no new statistical tests.
Each point is a donor–SpD observation; multiple points from one donor are not independent. Shared outcome y-axis.
Selection: Named in Results 2.4 for neuronal structure/outgrowth among PRS-associated genes. Its occurrence in both FGF neuropil-to-vascular screens merits
comparison; a vascular SPG label does not establish endothelial origin.
